Congress Leaders Divided Over Rahul Gandhi as PM Candidate

Two centrist Hindi outlets report a disagreement within the Congress party and its allies regarding Rahul Gandhi's suitability as a prime ministerial candidate. Reports indicate that some leaders, particularly from the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK), are pushing for actor Vijay to be considered. A minister reportedly warned that if Rahul Gandhi is not accepted as the PM face, they might resign.
